text:
oliver: New user reported our Python quickstart's sample app failing with 400 when calling embeddings. Suspect doc/sample drift.

Tess: can you paste the snippet they ran?

oliver: From docs:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(os.getenv('API_KEY'))
emb = client.embeddings.create(input='hello')
```

Tess: hmm our SDK's method is `client.embeddings.generate` not `create`. create used to exist in older clients.

oliver: yea that's the problem. docs and sample repo are out of sync. user copy-pasted from quickstart page.

Tess: docs-bot, search for `embeddings.create` across docs and examples.

docs-bot: Found 5 occurrences: docs/quickstart/python/index.md, examples/python/basic/app.py, examples/python/.env.example (comment), and two tutorials. Recommend updating to `embeddings.generate` and adding a deprecation note.

oliver: also the import line on some pages says `pip install redwood` which doesn't match our PyPI package `redwood-inference`. confusing for newbies.

Tess: open PR to fix samples + quickstart and add a tiny unit test that imports from the installed package and calls embeddings.generate with a dummy key. CI can catch this.

ci-bot: created job `samples-smoke` and ran on PR: failed due to import error on `from redwood import Client` because packaging changed to `import redwood_inference as redwood` in 0.9.0.

oliver: okay multiple moving parts: method name changed, package import name changed, env var name inconsistent. Let's converge: 1) standardize examples to `from redwood import Client` (we keep alias in package), 2) use `embeddings.generate`, 3) ensure .env.example shows `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

Tess: I'll prepare the docs PR and add a CI smoke test `python -c "from redwood import Client; Client('x').embeddings.generate('a')"`. Also add a short note in quickstart about package name blurb: "pip install redwood-inference (import as `from redwood import Client`)".

oliver: filing SDK issue to keep `embeddings.create` as a thin shim that raises a descriptive DeprecationError directing to `embeddings.generate`. URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/299

docs-bot: PR #612 opened to update code samples and add the CI smoke test.

Tess: great. also adding a small troubleshooting FAQ entry: "Why am I seeing TypeError or AttributeError when running quickstart?" with checklist: wrong import, old method names, wrong env var.

oliver: thanks. will follow-up to notify support and add a canned reply. :white_check_mark:
